market_summary: Strong directional moves across markets during the New York session. USD strength continues to drive XAUUSD and EURUSD aggressively lower below Value Area Lows with aligned bearish CVD. Equity index momentum remains very strong on US100 breaking out above VAH to new highs. GBPUSD and BTCUSD are experiencing temporary consolidation and divergence near key structural levels.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4032.34) and below POC (4043.60). CVD is BEARISH (-2.15) with negative slope, confirming strong selling pressure in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4040.03) and EMA50 (4036.30), expanding beyond lower ATR band (4009.68). Breakdown below Session Low 4000.54 was backed by recent yellow RVOL spikes. High-probability continuation scalp lower.

Price is below VAL (1.11034) and POC (1.11376). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-15,536) with negative slope (-1154.51) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trending strongly under VWAP (1.11298) and EMA50 (1.11280), positioned at lower ATR band (1.10943). Previous breakdown was confirmed by yellow RVOL spikes. Live price bounce is weak; continuation short remains aligned with order flow.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR / near Session Low 1.10824

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (1.32661..1.33251) and slightly above POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,562) with a positive short-term slope (+3309.28) showing intraday bounce pressure. Price remains below VWAP (1.33092) and EMA50 (1.33104), testing mid-channel near lower ATR band. Mixed signals between trend and CVD slope inside value area warrant a HOLD.
signals.level_event: rejection off Session Low 1.32661 / mid-range bounce

signals.rationale: Price is trading well above VAH (28299.47) and POC (28263.55). CVD is BULLISH (+11.73) with positive slope (+3.42) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is cleanly trending above upward-sloping VWAP (28153.31) and EMA50 (28199.53), pushing above upper ATR band (28438.94). Index tick volume caveat applies for RVOL. Strong trend acceptance above value area supports long continuation.
signals.level_event: acceptance above upper ATR band testing Session High 28471.88

signals.rationale: Price is trading above VAH (73920.85) and POC (73650.62). However, CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06) with flat slope, showing bearish divergence against the recent price push into resistance. Price is above VWAP (73703.48) and EMA50 (73751.00), consolidated right near upper ATR band (74413.17). Absence of strong exchange volume spikes and conflicting CVD suggest holding for clearer resolution.
signals.level_event: rejection at S/R 74254.90 below Session High 74384.10
